title: JSON-LD Modeler model
description: A .jsonld.yaml model file. The file is about JSON-LD; it is not itself JSON-LD.

jsonld.description: The version of this model format the file is written against.

namespace.description: The prefix and base IRI that give this model's own terms their global identity.

project.description: The project this model belongs to. The named project's file must list this model. A model that declares none behaves exactly as it did before projects existed.

mode.description: The JSON-LD processing mode this model targets. A property of the model, never a flag on a command.

vocab.description: @vocab for the emitted context. Makes every unmapped key expand rather than drop.

prefixes.description: Prefix declarations. Each emits as a term in the generated context.

uses.description: Contexts this model builds on but does not own. Referenced, not flattened.

terms.description: A flat map from JSON key to term definition. A term is never declared as belonging to a class.

examples.description: Example documents by path, each with the outcome validating it must produce.

views.description: Named subsets of the model, each forming one pair of diagrams.

elementId.description: A short stable identity. Both the key and the IRI are mutable attributes of it.

prefixName.description: A prefix a compact IRI may use. Declared here so the schema reference documents the key shape that `prefixes` enforces.

termKey.description: A JSON key a term may map. Any non-empty string that does not begin with `@`, because a key beginning with `@` is a JSON-LD keyword position.

iri.description: An absolute IRI, a compact IRI (prefix:suffix), or a relative reference.

containerCombination.title: A legal @container combination
containerCombination.description: @list combines with nothing. Otherwise at most one container beyond @set, except that @graph may pair with @id or @index.

reverseContainerFacet.title: A reverse property's container
reverseContainerFacet.description: A term declaring @reverse may carry @container: @set or @index, and nothing else.

reverseExclusiveFacet.title: A reverse property's identity
reverseExclusiveFacet.description: A term declaring @reverse names its IRI through @reverse, so it may not also carry @id or @nest.

inlineContext.description: A scoped context: null, an IRI, an inline object, or an array of those.

term.description: One JSON-LD term definition. Every 1.1 facet is expressible, plus a raw escape hatch.

@id.description: The IRI the key maps to. `null` drops the term.

@type.description: Type coercion. `@id` is what makes a string a reference rather than a label.

@container.description: The JSON shape a value takes. With the exception of @list, changes no triple.

@protected.description: The only facet that constrains what a later context may do.

@context.description: A term-scoped context. Its effect is positional: it applies below this point.

@nest.description: @nest, or a term that itself expands to @nest.

@prefix.description: Whether this term may be used as a compact-IRI prefix.

raw.description: Any construct the metamodel has not yet given a name. Merged into the emitted definition; reaches the context unchanged.

note.description: Documentation for this term. Carried by the model; a @context cannot hold it.

integrity.description: The hash of the vendored copy this entry was resolved against. Written by `ldm vendor`.

expect.description: What validating this document must produce. A negative example names the rule ids it must raise.
